notes.title: DLC "Märchen Forest: Requiem of the astral world" has been released!
notes.notes:
Today, on 9.13, 2018, a large scale DLC "Märchen Forest: Requiem of the astral world" has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864220/

For details on how to access additional contents, refer to the following guide.

[How to access DLC Start.]

For the access to the additional star content, "Astral world", the following conditions must be satisfied.

●Part 2 has been cleared.
(There is no need to clear it once again if you have cleared it once)

If you meet the conditions, please head to the cave shown below with possession of "Rozalina's Stone".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557171/d689e9b2398327b932c51ba0424d8c5177ea135b.jpg[/img]

Once you enter the cave you will be able to access the star hidden world by going all the way to the end.

notes.title: Schedule to release 9/13 DLC "Requiem of the astral world"!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to inform you that the release date of the large scale DLC "Requiem of the astral world" of "Marchen Forest" has been decided below.

[Scheduled release date]
PST 2018/9/13 0:00 Release schedule

【Update contents】
· Added a new dungeon "Astral world" and accompanying story
· Addition of new system "Ability"
· New system "weapon strengthening" · "war skill" addition
· By various other additional factors, evolve to game volume more than double the conventional content!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557171/4703808e866cfa1541117ccd7e4a9421ed0b505a.png[/img]

In the world after Episode 2 clearance, an additional dungeon "Episode 3" with an average playing time of more than 20 hours will be added.

"Astral world" gives great strategy and diversity to the battle by adding many systems such as "abilities", "war skill", "weapon enhancement" as a new system.

The story added by DLC is told about the past of "follower Rozalina", it will give players new mystery and new impression.


※This DLC is Japanese ver. Only. Multilingual correspondence will be in order to go on from now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864220/
